{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python - <<'EOF'
from tinydb import TinyDB, where
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage, JSONStorage
from tinydb.journal import BatchWriter
import tempfile, os

# non-contiguous IDs: preview must match what apply/insert would produce
db = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
w = BatchWriter(db)
db.insert({'x': 1}); db.insert({'x': 2}); db.remove(where('x') == 1)
assert w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 3}}]) == [3], w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 3}}])
assert w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 3}}]) == [3]
print('non-contiguous preview OK')

# fresh table (no cache): max+1
db2 = TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)
db2.insert({'x': 1}); db2.insert({'x': 2}); db2.remove(where('x') == 1)
w2 = BatchWriter(db2)
assert w2.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 3}}]) == [3]
print('fresh-handle preview OK')

# apply return list detached
r = w2.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 4}}])
r.append(999)
assert w2.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 5}}]) == [5]
print('apply return detached OK')

# preview with JSON storage (string keys) + error
p = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'd.json')
db3 = TinyDB(p, storage=JSONStorage)
w3 = BatchWriter(db3)
assert w3.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]) == [1]
assert w3.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}}]) == [2]
try:
    w3.preview([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 99}])
    raise SystemExit('should raise')
except ValueError:
    pass
assert w3.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}}]) == [2]
db3.close()
print('json preview OK')
EOF"}
